name: Estonia
description: Estonia from its ancient tribes to Danish, German, Swedish and Russian rule, independence in 1918, Soviet occupation, the Singing Revolution and a digital state.

checkpoints.name: Crusaders and empires
checkpoints.note: German and Danish crusaders conquered the land in the 1200s. Sweden and then Russia ruled it.

checkpoints.name: The first republic
checkpoints.note: Estonia declared independence in 1918 and won it in war.

checkpoints.name: Soviet occupation
checkpoints.note: The Soviet Union occupied Estonia in 1940 and, after the German years, again in 1944. The Singing Revolution grew in the late 1980s.

checkpoints.name: Free and digital
checkpoints.note: Estonia was free again in 1991, joined the EU and NATO in 2004 and built one of the world's most digital states.
